$comment: Schema for protocol/non_register_entities.canonical.json — calculated ESPHome / ESP32-browser-UI / local-config entities that are NOT BMS registers (spec section 5.4).

category.description: mock_backend_only: published only by demo/mock-server.js (a browser-registered route with no production batterylifepo4.yaml/components publisher); listed so the UI never treats it as a BMS register, without implying firmware support. protocol_infrastructure: an internal runtime signal consumed by the pipeline itself (e.g. read-block success markers), never a user-facing parameter: it must render in neither the Settings register list nor the Diagnostics value list (test_runtime_key_space.js, test_diagnostic_software_variables_scroll.js).

esphome_configured_name.description: Exact `name:` of the production ESPHome entity (batterylifepo4.yaml or a generated include) that publishes this key, which must be non-internal. null when no production publisher exists (browser-only, mock-only, unpublished). tools/protocol/authoring/build_protocol_entity_routes.js generates a browser route ONLY for non-null values; web_server SSE ids and ESPHome's object_id (slug of this name) derive from it.

esphome_yaml_id.description: The publisher's YAML `id:` (null if it has none, or no publisher). Used only to also route the id-form wire ids the browser already accepted where the YAML id differs from ESPHome's name-derived object_id.

derived_from_register_key.description: Stage 5: when this computed entity is a direct, same-read derivation of one real register field (e.g. total_voltage from total_voltage_raw), names that field's key so generate.js's buildFieldMeta() can inherit its poll_group/freshness_budget_s instead of leaving this entity permanently un-stale-able. Omit/null when there is no single real register this value traces to (e.g. power = V x I, computed from two different registers).
